extractedText: 2025 Q4 Revenue : Press Release – 23/02/2026 Published on 02/23/2026 at 04:43 pm EST Publicnow Share FREELANCE.COM -0.94% Press Release - 23 February 2026 4thquarter 2025 revenue: €273.4m (-5.7%) Full year 2025 revenue: €1,052.6m (+0.3%) Freelance.com (Euronext Growth Paris - FR0004187367 - ALFRE), a leader in the relationship between companies and their external talents, publishes consolidated results for the 4thquarter of 2025. Revenues (unaudited consolidated data, in €m) 2025 consolidated Change 9-month revenue 779.2 +2.6% 4thquarter revenue 273.4 -5.7% Full year revenue 1,052.6 +0.3% In the 4thquarter, the group's revenue amounted to €273.4m, a 6% year-on-year decline (-5% organically). In France, Freelance.com delivered consolidated revenue of €198.6m in the 4thquarter, down 9% compared with the 4thquarter of 2024 (-8% organically). Internationally, Freelance.com generated revenue of €74.8m in the 4thquarter, up 3% compared with the 4thquarter of 2024 (+3% organic growth). Consolidated revenue for the full year of 2025 amounted to €1,052.6m, up 0.3% compared to 2024 (-3% organically). French activities declined by 1%, reaching €767.6m (-6% organically). International activities increased by 3%, reaching €285.0m (+3% organically). The Group's 2025 pro forma sales amounted to €1,050.3m when excluding Provigis' revenue (sold in June 2025). Steep slowdown of French business on the back of strong comparable year on year quarter, confirmed stabilization of the international division The French segment (-6% in 2025) suffered from the performance of its wage portage and intermediation businesses amid a difficult macroeconomic context which continues to weigh on the dynamism of the self-employed market. The Group's 4thquarter performance is particularly impacted by a strong comparable 4thquarter 2024, despite a slowdown in the sales decline of wage portage activities. The international scope (+3% in 2025) confirmed its stabilization over the year, reaching positive organic growth over each quarter. Upcoming events Full-year 2025 results: 20 April 2026. 1stquarter 2026 revenues: 18 May 2026. Annual General Meeting: 12 June 2026. About Freelance.com Positioned at the heart of the transformation of the labor market, Freelance.com is a European leader in Talent as a Service (TAAS) solutions, connecting large companies with their external talents. The group offers a full range of services: expertise sourcing, project management, commercial support, wage portage, and compliance management. Freelance.com relies on a community of over 150,000 (106,000 in France) qualified consultants and experts, working as freelancers or within highly specialized SMEs, having delivered a total of more than 19,000 services in 2025. With 350 employees and a proforma turnover of 1,050.3 million euros in 2025, a presence in France and internationally (Switzerland, Belgium, Morocco, England, Germany), Freelance.com is a reference player in the "Future of Work", recognized as one of the "Growth Champions" for 2026 by Les Echos and as one of TIME's 2026 " World's Most Sustainable Companies".
